Package com.stockly.model

Class Product

java.lang.Object
com.stockly.model.Product
public class Product extends Object
A single product in the inventory.

The name and quantity are JavaFX properties so that a TableView or a dashboard card bound to this object refreshes automatically when a value changes. The stock status is read-only: it is recalculated whenever the quantity changes, so it can never disagree with the quantity.

The properties are exposed as read-only. All modifications must go through setName(String) and setQuantity(int), which protect the object's invariants (non-blank name, non-negative quantity).

Author:
Umama Wahab
